about: Titan's Rest's road, one sample every ds metres round the lap. Game axes, metres: x east, y up, z south (Blender: (x, -z, y)). p is the centreline, t the direction of travel, r to the right, u up out of the deck (all banked and rolled with the road). hw is the half width; road says whether there is deck on the left and right (no deck over the Crown Drop's gap); wall whether a barrier stands on each edge; through the Hull's fork each route is drawn moved across by shift and up by rise from the centreline, with a wall of half width median between them. The space the titan must leave empty is, at each sample, from KEEP_OUT.side past each edge and from KEEP_OUT.down below the deck to KEEP_OUT.up above it (each route of the fork its own box), along the road a sample either way.
